articles.title: Europe's high regulatory bar could spark new crypto industry M&A wave
articles.snippet: As MiCA beds in and the U.K. finalizes its crypto framework, stringent regulation could spur mergers, acquisitions and closer ties with banks.

articles.title: Russia’s largest bank Sberbank plans crypto trading infrastructure by December
articles.snippet: New regulations for crypto trading, custody, and settlement in Russia take effect Sept. 1, with requirements for licensed intermediaries applying from July 2027.

articles.title: North Korea arrests hackers accused of laundering stolen funds from country's bank via crypto
articles.snippet: The group allegedly breached Central Bank systems, converted crypto to cash via Chinese brokers, and used small transfers to evade detection.

articles.title: Institutional crypto trading platform LMAX is exploring sale, IPO
articles.snippet: LMAX is working with Morgan Stanley and investment bank KBW to assess its options, which could lead to a sale or a public offering.

articles.title: Brazilian farmers tokenized dairy cows to get loans, bypassing bank lending limits
articles.snippet: Smart collars monitor herd health in real time to prevent fraud, allowing local agricultural businesses to secure thousands in funding backed by livestock.
